revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY23-25 revenue CAGR ~2.4% (depressed by FX/refranchising); modest recovery to mid-single-digit via pricing and volume, fading toward 4% as a mature staples business.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 margin 28.7% (13,762/47,941) but FY2023 24.7% and FY2024 21.2% were lower (impairments/other charges); 28% held flat as slightly conservative.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. US 21% statutory blended with lower foreign rates; not taken from a filing figure.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 0.67 (Damodaran Beverage (Soft) cash-corrected unlevered 0.575, D/E 0.206, tax 21%) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = CoE 7.8%; pretax Kd 5.29% (Damodaran) after tax 4.2%; weights 83/17 (Damodaran industry D/E) => ~7.2%. terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal US GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate; mature staples franchise. Note: the terminal value is ~80% of EV, which is typical for a 5-year DCF of a stable, low-WACC, low-capex-intensity business. I kept the assumptions unchanged rather than tune them to lower the share; the reviewer should treat the result as sensitive to WACC and g.
